name: DreamerV3
summary: DreamerV3 applies symlog prediction, two-hot value encoding, free bits and normalized returns to make the Dreamer recipe robust across radically different domains without per-task tuning. It masters continuous control, Atari, and open-world Minecraft with identical settings, and shows monotonically better performance and data efficiency as model size grows.
innovation: A set of normalization and transformation tricks that make one hyperparameter configuration work everywhere.
Demonstrated favorable scaling laws for world models: bigger model, better and more data-efficient.
matters: Established world models as a general-purpose learning substrate, not a benchmark-specific trick.
limits: Still reconstruction-based, which spends capacity modeling visually salient but task-irrelevant detail.
lineage: The Dreamer line hardened for robustness and scale.
